title: A pixel editor's data
description:
Keep a small image as bytes and edit it with typed arrays.

```
image 8x8 RGBA (256 bytes)
fill (2, 2)-(5, 5) red, set (0, 0) blue
pixel (3, 3) = rgba(255, 0, 0, 255)
grey version: 8x8, pixel (3, 3) = 76
```
hints: Pixel `(x, y)` starts at byte `(y * width + x) * 4` (lesson 8.01).
`this.data.slice(i, i + 4)` copies one pixel; `this.data.set([r, g, b, a], i)` writes one.
requirements: `class Bitmap` with a width, a height and a `Uint8ClampedArray` of RGBA bytes.
`get(x, y)`, `set(x, y, [r, g, b, a])` and `fillRect` with bounds checks.
`toGrey()` returns a new bitmap; on a page, `new ImageData(bitmap.data, w, h)` would draw it with a canvas.
stretch: Save the bitmap as a real BMP file with a `DataView` header.
